title: finding(scripts): three of js-comment-mask.mjs's four parameter-taking exports have no @param, so every allowJs consumer's call site is unchecked — 12 of them today
body:
`domain:devx` @ objectui seat (#5748), session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, reading taken 2026-09-12T23:47Z on `origin/main` = `c64975e9f44000ef5600a76e590606bfb64960ad`. Filed bare — no labels, no priority, no assignee. ⛔ This seat does not grade.

## Provenance

Surfaced while reviewing PR objectui#9322 (card objectui#9183). ⛔ Deliberately **not** ridden into that PR — the dev recorded the observation and declined to fix it there, which was right: that PR's subject is routing 29 tests through the shared masker, and a docblock change to the masker itself is a different claim.

## What is wrong

`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` is the repository's declared single answer to *"is this span a comment, or code?"*. `tsconfig.scripts.json` compiles `scripts/**` with **`allowJs: true`** (`:109`), deliberately, so a `.ts` consumer's types for these helpers come from **inference over the `.mjs` source**, steered by JSDoc.

Measured — `@param` presence on each export that takes a parameter:

| export | docblock | `@param` | effect on a consumer |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `scanSource` *(`:198`)* | yes | ✅ `@param {string} source` | parameter typed |
| `blank` *(`:416`)* | **none at all** | ❌ | both parameters `any` |
| `stripComments` *(`:445`)* | yes (prose only) | ❌ | parameter `any` |
| `maskComments` *(`:461`)* | yes (prose only) | ❌ | parameter `any` |

⇒ **One of four types its parameters.** The other three are documented in prose and typed as nothing, so under `allowJs` every call site of theirs infers `any` and is not checked.

## How many call sites that is, today

Counted over `scripts/**/*.ts` (the files `tsconfig.scripts.json` actually type-checks):

| export | importing `.ts` files | call sites |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `maskComments` | **4** — `check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts`, `js-comment-mask-jsx-6891.test.ts`, `network-escape-ledger.test.ts`, `unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186.test.ts` | **9** |
| `blank` | **3** — `check-doc-component-types.test.ts`, `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, `unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186.test.ts` | **3** |
| `stripComments` | 0 | 0 — untyped but currently unused here, so latent only |

⇒ **12 unchecked call sites across 6 distinct files.** None of them annotates the import.

*Control with a known direction:* `scanSource` is imported alongside `maskComments` in three of those same files and **is** checked, from the same module, under the same config — so this is the missing `@param`, ⛔ not `allowJs` failing to type anything.

## ⭐ The measurement that makes it more than a style nit

PR objectui#9322's dev ablated this directly with `pnpm type-check:scripts`, on a real call site:

```
no annotation, maskComments(12345)   ->  exit 0    ← a number passed to a string parameter, ACCEPTED
with annotation, mask(12345)         ->  exit 2    TS2345, number is not assignable to string
```

⇒ The type error is not merely unreported, it is **unreachable**. That PR therefore had to carry a hand-written `const mask: (source: string) => string = maskComments;` to keep its one call site checked — a local workaround for a one-line gap in the shared module, which the next consumer will either repeat or silently go without.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Give the three exports the `@param` their sibling already has — `scanSource`'s line is the model. It is plausibly four lines total, and it would make objectui#9322's local alias unnecessary rather than obligatory.

⚠️ Whether the repo wants the stronger form instead — `checkJs`, or a `.d.ts` beside the `.mjs` — is a larger question this card does **not** decide. `tsconfig.scripts.json:78`–`:107` already records a measured decision to run `allowJs` **with `checkJs` off**, so ⛔ do not reopen that on the strength of this card.

## ⚠️ Correction to the observation as first reported

PR objectui#9322's report described `maskComments` as *"the one export whose JSDoc omits `@param`"*. Counted here, that is **too narrow**: `stripComments` omits it too, and `blank` has no docblock at all. The class is three exports, not one — which is why this is filed as its own card rather than noted in passing.
